body_html:
You directly provide CfA with most of the data we collect. We collect and process data when you:

  • Register online or subscribe for any of our products, services, communities, events or newsletters.
  • Voluntarily complete a partner/participant survey.
  • Provide feedback on any of our message boards or via email.
  • Use or view our website.

CfA may also receive your data indirectly from research tools that our editorial and journalism teams use for analysing mis-/disinformation on social media platforms.
headline: How do we collect your data?
